query: UPDATE bookings b SET status = 'completed', completed_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE b.status = 'seated' AND b.ends_at + interval '60 minutes' < now() AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM branches fb JOIN organizations fo ON fo.id = fb.org_id WHERE fb.id = b.branch_id AND fo.plan = 'free') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_tickets ot WHERE ot.booking_id = b.id AND ot.status = 'open') AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_tickets ot WHERE ot.booking_id = b.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_tickets ot WHERE ot.booking_id = b.id AND ot.status = 'settled')) RETURNING b.id
